display.purpose: The primary charge amount. Designed to be readable at a glance from a distance.

shadows.name: subtle-lift
shadows.purpose: Applied to keypad buttons to separate them from the background.

shadows.name: primary-glow
shadows.purpose: Applied exclusively to the primary Action button and slide-over panels.

components.name: Keypad Button
components.css: .ds-btn-keypad { background: #ffffff; color: #111827; height: 64px; width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.5rem; border: 1px solid #e5e7eb; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 rgba(0,0,0,0.05); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-keypad:active { background: #f3f4f6; }

components.name: Charge Button
components.description: The main action button to initiate payment.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #2563eb; color: #ffffff; height: 64px; width: 100%; border-radius: 16px; font-weight: 700; font-size: 1.25rem; border: none; box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0,0,0,0.1); cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #1d4ed8; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; box-shadow: none; cursor: not-allowed; }

narrative.overview: A clean, stark white, high-contrast interface designed to sit natively alongside Stripe Terminal and Square POS. The design discards earlier sci-fi or rugged tropes in favor of a purely functional, professional aesthetic. It relies on crisp typography, generous touch targets, and stark separation of planes (gray backgrounds vs. white interactive surfaces) rather than heavy borders or stylized effects.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast legibility for bright retail environments.
Large, reliable touch targets (16px radius minimum for primary actions).
Utilitarian hierarchy driven by weight and scale, not color.
Action-oriented accenting: color is reserved exclusively for the primary 'Charge' action and active states.

rules.name: The Action Isolation Rule
rules.body: The primary blue is used only for the terminal's main objective (charging/confirming) and active notification states. Never use it for decoration or secondary actions.

rules.name: The Numeric Primacy Rule
rules.body: The charge amount is always the largest element on the screen, rendered in Extra Bold, ensuring the merchant and customer are never in doubt of the transaction state.

rules.name: The Flat Plane Rule
rules.body: Depth is structural, not decorative. Use shadows only to indicate interactivity (buttons) or elevation over the primary canvas (bottom sheets/modals).

dos: Do ensure all interactive touch targets are at least 48px high.
Do use the Action Blue solely for the terminal's primary intent.
Do maintain maximum contrast (gray-900 on white) for all monetary amounts.
donts: Don't reintroduce dark mode. The application must remain light and legible in variable retail environments.
Don't use decorative gradients, glassmorphism, or heavy borders.
